1. Go to **Companies**.
2. Select **New company**.
3. Enter the **Company name**. All other fields are optional.
4. Optionally add the **Industry**, **Phone**, **Website** and **Address**.
5. Select **Save company**.

To add people to the company, link each contact to it: open the contact under **Contacts**, select **Edit**, choose the company in the **Company** list, then select **Save contact**.
